workflow.name: Tito Daily — Error Handler
workflow.description: Shared error handler for the Tito Finance tracker. Triggered by any linked workflows failure, extracts the workflow name, failed node, error and Lagos timestamp, and emails the details via Gmail.

parameters.content:
## Shared error handler
All five tracker workflows point here via **Settings > Error Workflow**, so failure
notification lives in one place instead of being rebuilt per workflow.

Fires only for **production** executions — manual test runs never reach it. A workflow
that has its own Error Trigger would use that instead; none of ours do.

**Tunable:** recipient in **Config**, timezone at the top of **Extract Failure Details**.

To move alerts to Telegram once the bot credential exists, swap **Email the Failure**
for a Telegram sendMessage to Samuels personal chat ID — not the team group.

triggerInfo: This workflow's trigger(s) are not supported for direct execution through MCP: On Workflow Failure. Only Schedule, Webhook, Form, and Chat triggers can be executed directly through MCP, so this workflow cannot be executed through MCP. Its trigger(s) still run normally when the workflow is active.
